Right_InternalAnalytics.quote: Client may use the Licensed Data for its internal analytics, reporting and benchmarking for its own direct benefit.

Right_AIML.quote: Client shall not use the Licensed Data to train, fine-tune or validate any machine learning or artificial intelligence model.

Right_ProductDevelopment.quote: Client may incorporate analytical outputs derived from the Licensed Data into Client's commercial products and services only with Provider's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

Right_Retention.quote: Client's right to use the Licensed Data continues for twelve (12) months after the final delivery of Licensed Data under this SOW, after which Client shall cease all use of the Licensed Data. Client may keep one (1) archival copy of the Licensed Data solely for audit and legal-compliance purposes.

Right_ThirdPartySharing.quote: Client shall not sell, license, distribute or disclose the Licensed Data to any third party.

Right_DataLinking.quote: Client may link the Licensed Data to its own datasets provided it does not append Provider's record identifiers to any data supplied by a third party and does not attempt to identify any individual.

Right_Destruction.quote: Within thirty (30) days after expiration or termination of this SOW, Client shall destroy all Licensed Data and certify the destruction in writing, except for the one (1) archival copy described in Section 9.1.
